# 1b — Mina Daemon

Deploy this component after the archive node (`1a`). The daemon connects to the
network. The archive requires block data from the daemon.

The `helmfile.yaml` file in this runbook contains two releases. One release
deploys the daemon. The other release deploys the `graphql-proxy` Service and
Ingress that expose the GraphQL endpoint.

## Purpose

`node-0` is a full node. It does not produce blocks or do SNARK work. It
communicates with peers and validates the chain. It supplies these services:

- **Blocks for the archive node** through the archive RPC at `archive:3086`.
- **GraphQL on `:3085`** for the treasury CLI and browser. They use GraphQL to
  read account state and submit zkApp transactions.

```text
  network peers <--p2p 10801--> node-0 (mina) --(archive:3086)--> archive-node
                                     |
                                     +-- :3085 graphql --> graphql-proxy --> treasury
```

The treasury submits all on-chain transactions through this daemon. The archive
stores the data that it receives from this daemon. If the daemon is not
`Synced`, both data paths stop.

## Components

| Component       | Object                                               | Role                                                                             |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Daemon          | `Deployment/node-0`, container `mina`                | Runs the Mina node                                                               |
| Public proxy    | container `graphql-public-proxy` (same pod, `:3000`) | Read-only GraphQL filter for public exposure                                     |
| Daemon service  | `Service/node-0`                                     | p2p `10801`, client `8301`                                                       |
| GraphQL service | `Service/node-0-graphql`                             | `3085` (graphql), `3000` (proxy)                                                 |
| libp2p keys     | init container + secret                              | Creates the keys on the first start (`libp2pKeys.create: true`)                  |
| Proxy service   | `Service/graphql-proxy`                              | Selects pods with the `exposeGraphql: "true"` label. It does not run a workload. |
| Proxy ingress   | `Ingress/graphql-proxy`                              | Supplies the public HTTPS entry point. Step 2 identifies the example values.     |

**There is no PVC.** The ledger is temporary. Each restart causes a full resync
from peers. It does not resume the previous sync. Include the resync time in the
restart plan.

- Charts: [https://github.com/MinaFoundation/helm-charts.git](https://github.com/MinaFoundation/helm-charts.git). Use
  `mina-daemon`, pinned to `mina-daemon-2.1.1`, and `raw` for the proxy objects.
- Image tag: Use the network release announcement in
  [https://github.com/MinaProtocol/mina/discussions](https://github.com/MinaProtocol/mina/discussions). See step 1.
- Values: Use `helmfile.yaml` in this directory.

## Prerequisites

- Apply runbook `1a`. `Service/archive` must resolve on `:3086`.
- Configure `kubectl` for the `production` cluster and the `devnet` namespace.
- Make sure that the target nodepool can accept a 16Gi / 4 CPU request.
- Supply a DNS name and a TLS certificate if the endpoint will be public.

## 1. Pick The Image Tag

Use the same build as the archive node (`1a`). If the builds differ, the archive
rejects blocks without an error message.

Get the tags from the official network release announcement in
[https://github.com/MinaProtocol/mina/discussions](https://github.com/MinaProtocol/mina/discussions). The Devnet 4.0.0 "Mesa"
announcement is [https://github.com/MinaProtocol/mina/discussions/19236](https://github.com/MinaProtocol/mina/discussions/19236). The
announcement also gives the Git commit SHA and the chain id. Step 5 verifies
these values.

```text
minaprotocol/mina-daemon:4.0.0-6965b50-<codename>-devnet
```

`<codename>` identifies the base OS. The options are focal, jammy, noble,
bullseye, and bookworm. This helmfile uses `bookworm`. Therefore, use
`4.0.0-6965b50-bookworm-devnet`.

Compare this value with the archive node image:

```bash
kubectl get deploy -n devnet archive-node \
  -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[*].image}{"\n"}'
```

## 2. Check The Values That Matter

| Value                                | Current                     | Why                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `deployment.testnet` / `peerListURL` | `devnet` / devnet bootnodes | An incorrect pair gives the incorrect chain id and prevents peer connections.                                              |
| `node.archive.enabled` / `address`   | `true` / `archive:3086`     | `archive` is the Service name from `1a`. These values enable the archive data path.                                        |
| `node.exposeGraphql`                 | `true`                      | Adds the `exposeGraphql: "true"` pod label that the proxy Service selects. Without this label, the proxy has no endpoints. |
| `podLabels.queryableNode`            | `"true"`                    | The staking ledger provider (`1c`) requires this label.                                                                    |
| `node.libp2pKeys.create`             | `true`                      | Creates a key pair on the first start.                                                                                     |
| `readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds` | `120`                       | The chart default is `1200`. That value kept the pod unready after the daemon reached `Synced`.                            |
| `resources`                          | 16Gi/4 → 24Gi/6             | Smaller resources cause an OOM kill during catch-up.                                                                       |

**The Ingress contains `<REPLACE: …>` placeholders.** Set the host and the
certificate ARN before you apply the resources. Adjust the annotations for your
ingress controller. The placeholder values intentionally prevent a valid
configuration. If the endpoint stays internal, remove the Ingress resource. The
Service is sufficient for internal treasury access.

Compare `nodeSelector` and `tolerations` with the live release. The daemon must
run on the `mina-daemon-spot` nodepool. Also compare the `serviceAccount` role
annotation. Removal of these values does not fail the apply operation. It can
schedule the pod on a different nodepool.

The chart reads `node.fileLogLevel`. It ignores a `filelogLevel` key without an
error message. The default value, `Error`, then applies.

## 3. Diff, Then Apply

```bash
cd devops/runbooks/1-Network/1b-Mina-Daemon
helmfile template . | kubectl diff -f -
helmfile template . | kubectl apply -f -
```

The update strategy is `Recreate`. A pod-template change stops the node before
the new node starts. The archive keeps its existing data. The guardian fills the
gap during its next hourly run.

## 4. Wait For Sync

```bash
kubectl get pods -n devnet -l app=node-0 -w
```

The pod reports `Ready` only after the readiness probe reads `Synced`. The probe
runs `mina client status --json | jq -r .sync_status`. A cold start moves through
bootstrap, catchup, and synced. This process can take a long time because the
ledger is not persistent.

## 5. Check The Daemon Status

Use this command for each daemon status check:

```bash
kubectl exec -n devnet deploy/node-0 -c mina -- mina client status
```

Use these four lines to determine node health:

```text
Git SHA-1:                                     6965b502ecd7959d50e4a9116529406ed44e85a8
Chain id:                                      ebfce0d570bc22eb041e1a7b0a46bbc3ed5d0a1030ef2ab5e36eef908b93eba8
Peers:                                         26
Sync status:                                   Synced
```

- **Git SHA-1**: This value must match the build commit in the image tag release
  page. For example, see [https://github.com/MinaProtocol/mina/discussions/19236](https://github.com/MinaProtocol/mina/discussions/19236).
  A mismatch shows that the running binary differs from the selected build.
- **Chain id**: This value must exactly match the value on the same release page.
  A different value means that the daemon joined a different network. Possible
  causes are an incorrect image, `testnet`, or peer list. Usually, the daemon
  cannot connect to peers on the different network. If it reaches a seed node,
  it can appear healthy but cannot serve the intended network.
- **Peers**: This value must be stable and well above zero. A node with 0–2 peers
  is isolated. First, check the peer list URL and egress.
- **Sync status**: This value must be `Synced`. `Bootstrap` or `Catchup` means
  that synchronization continues. `Offline` means that the daemon lost its
  network connection.

Run the check two times with a one-minute interval. `Block height` must increase
and stay close to `Max observed block height`.

## 6. Check GraphQL

Directly on the daemon:

```bash
kubectl exec -n devnet deploy/node-0 -c mina -- bash -c \
  'curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3085/graphql -H "content-type: application/json" \
     -d "{\"query\":\"{ syncStatus daemonStatus { blockchainLength } }\"}"'
```

Expect `{"data":{"syncStatus":"SYNCED","daemonStatus":{"blockchainLength":…}}}`.
The length must match the `Block height` value from the previous check.

Finally, query the Ingress that exposes the endpoint externally:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://<REPLACE: ingress host>/graphql \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"{ syncStatus daemonStatus { blockchainLength } }"}'
```

If this query fails but the in-cluster checks succeed, check the Ingress. Check
the `<REPLACE: …>` host and certificate placeholders, controller annotations,
and DNS. The daemon and proxy Service are not the cause in this condition.

## 7. Confirm The Archive Is Being Fed

Run this command two times with a one-minute interval. The `max_height` value
must increase.

```bash
kubectl exec -n devnet archive-postgresql-0 -- bash -c \
  'PGPASSWORD=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD psql -U $POSTGRES_USER -d archive \
     -c "SELECT max(height) FROM blocks;"'
```

If the height does not increase while the daemon is `Synced`, the archive link
has failed. Check `node.archive.address`. Confirm that `archive-node` is
`Running`.

## 8. Provide the Treasury Endpoint

The treasury reaches the daemon through the proxy Service. It does not use the
pod directly. Use the FQDN. A short name does not resolve in the nginx `/mina/`
route.

```yaml
minaNodeUpstream: http://graphql-proxy.devnet.svc.cluster.local:3085
```

The browser requires the public URL from the Ingress host:

```text
NEXT_PUBLIC_MINA_NODE_URL=https://devnet.minaprotocol.network/graphql
```

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom                                              | Cause / fix                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Peers: 0`                                           | `peerListURL` is incorrect or not reachable, or egress is blocked. Confirm that the URL resolves from inside the pod.                                                        |
| Chain id differs                                     | The image and peer list select different networks. Correct the pair. A restart without this correction does not solve the problem.                                           |
| Stays in `Bootstrap`/`Catchup`                       | This state is normal during a cold start because there is no PVC. If the state continues, check the memory limits. An OOM kill during catch-up restarts the complete resync. |
| Pod is not `Ready`, but status is `Synced`           | Check the readiness probe timing. Confirm that `readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds` is `120`, not the chart default of `1200`.                                               |
| Archive height does not increase, daemon is `Synced` | `node.archive.address` is incorrect, or `archive-node` is down. The archive address is a start argument. Correct it, and then restart the daemon.                            |
| Pod is `Pending`                                     | No node can accept the 16Gi/4 CPU request. Compare `nodeSelector` and `tolerations` with the nodepool.                                                                       |
| `graphql-proxy` has no endpoints                     | `node.exposeGraphql` is not `true`, or `node-0` is not `Ready`.                                                                                                              |
| Ingress is available but has no certificate          | The operator applied the `<REPLACE: …>` ARN placeholder without a replacement value.                                                                                         |

## Configuration File: `helmfile.yaml`

This is the complete `devops/runbooks/1-Network/1b-Mina-Daemon/helmfile.yaml` file.

[Download `helmfile.yaml`](pathname:///runbook-files/1-Network/1b-Mina-Daemon/helmfile.yaml)

```yaml
---
releases:
- name: node-0
  chart: git::https://github.com/MinaFoundation/helm-charts.git@mina-daemon?ref=mina-daemon-2.1.1
  values:
    - deployment:
        testnet: devnet
        name: devnet-node-0
        image: minaprotocol/mina-daemon:4.0.0-6965b50-bookworm-devnet
        peerListURL: https://bootnodes.minaprotocol.com/networks/devnet.txt
      podLabels:
        # Required by Staking Ledger Provider
        queryableNode: "true"
      node:
        name: node-0
        role: node
        replicas: 1
        # Adds the `exposeGraphql: "true"` pod label that the graphql-proxy
        # Service below selects on. Without it the proxy has no endpoints.
        exposeGraphql: true
        logLevel: Error
        fileLogLevel: Error
        libp2pKeys:
          enabled: true
          create: true
        archive:
          enabled: true
          address: archive:3086
      readinessProbe:
        # The chart's 1200s default leaves the pod unready long after it is
        # actually Synced.
        initialDelaySeconds: 120
        periodSeconds: 30
        timeoutSeconds: 25
      resources:
        memoryRequest: 16Gi
        cpuRequest: 4
        memoryLimit: 24Gi
        cpuLimit: 6

# Public GraphQL endpoint for the daemon: just a Service and an Ingress, hence
# the `raw` chart. The Service points straight at the node-0 pod.
- name: graphql-proxy
  chart: git::https://github.com/MinaFoundation/helm-charts.git@raw
  values:
    - resources:
        - apiVersion: v1
          kind: Service
          metadata:
            name: graphql-proxy
            labels:
              app: graphql-proxy
          spec:
            type: ClusterIP
            # Matches the label the mina-daemon chart adds when
            # node.exposeGraphql is true.
            selector:
              exposeGraphql: "true"
            ports:
              # Read-only proxy served by the graphql-public-proxy sidecar.
              - name: proxy
                protocol: TCP
                port: 3000
                targetPort: 3000
              # Full daemon GraphQL.
              - name: graphql
                protocol: TCP
                port: 3085
                targetPort: 3085

        # EXAMPLE ONLY - the values below are environment specific and the
        # placeholders will not work as written. Replace the host and the
        # certificate ARN, and adjust the annotations to your ingress
        # controller, before applying. Drop this resource entirely if the
        # endpoint does not need to be public.
        - apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
          kind: Ingress
          metadata:
            name: graphql-proxy
            annotations:
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: HTTP
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internet-facing
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/target-type: ip
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/listen-ports: '[{"HTTPS":443}]'
              alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/certificate-arn: "<REPLACE: ACM certificate ARN>"
          spec:
            ingressClassName: alb
            rules:
            # e.g. https://devnet.minaprotocol.network/graphql
            - host: "<REPLACE: devnet.example.com>"
              http:
                paths:
                - path: /
                  pathType: Prefix
                  backend:
                    service:
                      name: graphql-proxy
                      port:
                        number: 3085
```
